brief_prompt: One green cell divides into two while six replicated chromosomes separate into twelve sister chromatids, six moving into each daughter cell.
scene_lock: Locked straight-on scientific microscopy illustration of the exact same green cell material on the exact same dark background in every supplied frame.
ordered_events: The six magenta X-shaped replicated chromosomes move to and align along the center of the one cell.
Each X separates into exactly two sister chromatids without any chromosome lineage appearing or disappearing.
Exactly six sister chromatids move left and exactly six move right.
Only after that allocation, the single green cell membrane pinches into exactly two daughter cells, each containing six sister chromatids.
invariants: dark background, green cell material and mint membrane
six parent lineages and their two-child mapping
forbidden: chromosomes dissolving, multiplying, turning into organelles or leaving the cell
orange organelles or pink vertical donor bands

comparison.L1: one first/last-frame model call using the structured motion contract
comparison.L2: three adjacent first/last-frame calls using the same structured prompt, then deterministic concatenation
